d: Why did the ancient Maya bury human teeth in caves 26 kilometres away from where the bodies were buried? Discover the fascinating secrets of the Mayan Civilization through cutting-edge science! In this Sciencekaari episode, explore how DNA analysis, radiocarbon dating, genome sequencing and LiDAR technology are rewriting ancient history. Uncover Mayan burial rituals, human sacrifice theories, ancient caves, royal bloodlines, ancestral worship, Maya pyramids and the social hierarchy of one of the world's most mysterious civilizations.
